about: compiler/stage mutants covering StdWork merging, lexical report ordering, and counter reset completeness

mutants.name: selfhost-stage-drop-std-files-parsed
mutants.rule: StageReport must add StdWork.FilesParsed into the files_parsed counter total.

mutants.name: selfhost-stage-unsorted-report-keys
mutants.rule: StageReport must sort entries lexicographically by Name to match Go's encoding/json map key ordering.

mutants.name: selfhost-stage-reset-missed-counter
mutants.rule: StoreReset must clear every counter in the synchronized store back to zero.
